title: Stopped
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, frozen small town at night in winter, stopped clocks and faded New Year's Eve decorations, icy blue and tarnished gold tones, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. In this town it's been one minute to midnight for 27 years. ⏳

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: In Merrow Falls, it has been one minute to midnight for twenty-seven years.
scenes.image: an old clock tower above a snowy small town square at night, its hands nearly straight up

scenes.narration: Theo Park writes about strange towns for a living. Ghost towns. Cursed towns. Most of them are just sad. He figured Merrow Falls would be sad.
scenes.image: a young journalist with a notebook driving down a snowy two-lane road at dusk

scenes.narration: He crossed the town line at a quarter past four in the afternoon. His dashboard clock jumped to 11:59.
scenes.image: car dashboard glowing in the dark, snowfall streaking across the windshield

scenes.narration: So did his phone. So did his watch. And the seconds weren't moving.
scenes.image: close-up of a silver wristwatch on a man's wrist, its hands frozen near the top

scenes.narration: Main Street was spotless and ready for a party. Silver streamers. Paper stars. String lights over the square.
scenes.image: a small-town main street at night strung with silver streamers and glowing string lights, light snow

scenes.narration: The clock tower said 11:59. The bank clock. The diner clock. A grandfather clock in the antique shop window. Every hand, stuck one notch short of the top.
scenes.image: a tall grandfather clock in a frosted antique shop window, its hands nearly straight up

scenes.narration: People walked past him smiling. Sweaters from the nineties. Bottles of champagne. Nobody looked at the clocks.
scenes.image: townspeople in 1990s winter clothes carrying champagne through a snowy street, smiling

scenes.narration: In Merrow Falls, nobody ever looks up at a clock. They're afraid they'll see it move.
scenes.image: a crowd in a snowy square with their eyes carefully lowered, a clock tower looming above

scenes.narration: Theo stopped a woman outside the diner and asked her what time it was. She smiled and said: almost.
scenes.image: a smiling woman in a 1990s parka outside a glowing small-town diner at night

scenes.narration: Then she looked past him, at the road out of town. It was gone. Just snow and dark pines, where the road had been.
scenes.image: a snowy forest edge at night where a road simply ends, dark pines and untouched snow
